point: Topic: join the problem and the fix.
主旨題：把問題和做法串起來。
why: The woman describes cracked returns, then a camera that can push the bad ones off the line. Together they show the topic: catching damaged bottles before they leave the plant.
女方先說退貨裡有裂瓶，再說相機可以 push the bad ones off the line。合起來，主題就是在出廠前找出受損的瓶子。

point: Compare the two numbers: forty and thirty-eight.
比較兩個數字：四十和三十八。
why: He asks Did they test it? She answers forty of our own cracked bottles and It caught thirty-eight. Only two were missed, so nearly all the faulty bottles were found.
他問 Did they test it?，她答 forty of our own cracked bottles、It caught thirty-eight。只漏掉兩瓶，所以幾乎全部有瑕疵的瓶子都找出來了。

point: Trace it and them back to their nouns.
把 it 和 them 追回前面的名詞。
why: He says the plant manager won't look at it unless the finance office has checked the numbers first. She replies I'll take it over to them first thing tomorrow: it is the summary, them the finance office.
他說廠長 won't look at it unless the finance office has checked the numbers first。她答 I'll take it over to them first thing tomorrow：it 是摘要，them 是財務室。

gloss.ex: A hairline crack ran along the pipe.
The pallet holds forty boxes.
Boxes move along the conveyor to packing.
The finance office approves every purchase.
Please check the figures before the meeting.

point: Topic: a problem plus its solution.
主旨題：問題加上解決辦法。
why: The maps are too delicate to photograph or take out of the building, so the speakers turn to scanning: Could the library scan them instead? The topic is how a student can study materials that cannot be borrowed.
地圖 too delicate to photograph or take out of the building，所以大家改談掃描：Could the library scan them instead? 主題是學生要怎麼研究不能外借的資料。

point: Do the sum with two times.
用兩個時間算一算。
why: The reading room closes at five, and he says I teach until four thirty. That leaves about half an hour, so his teaching schedule gives him little time there.
閱覽室 closes at five，而他說 I teach until four thirty。只剩大約半小時，所以他的課表讓他在那裡的時間很少。

point: Trace it back to the letter.
把 it 追回前面的信。
why: Mr. Dunmore asks for a short letter of support. She says Joel, could you draft it tonight? and he answers Of course. Joel will write the letter for his professor to sign.
Dunmore 先生要 a short letter of support。她說 Joel, could you draft it tonight?，他答 Of course。Joel 會寫信讓教授簽名。

gloss.ex: Her thesis covers port history.
The special collections room closes at five.
The old paper is very delicate.
She joined the waiting list for the class.
He asked for a letter of support.

point: Reason: join two turns.
原因題：把兩句話接起來。
why: He says My wife and our daughter are coming along after all. She replies Then you'll want more than one bed. More guests are traveling with him.
他說 My wife and our daughter are coming along after all。她接 Then you'll want more than one bed。同行的客人變多了。

point: Graphic: two clues give the row, the day gives the column.
圖表題：兩個線索定列，日期定欄。
why: He needs two beds but not a separate sitting area, so the row is the Family Room. He stays this Friday night, so use the Fri–Sat column: $195.
他要兩張床但不要 a separate sitting area，所以是 Family Room。他住 this Friday night，所以看 Fri–Sat 欄：$195。

point: An if clause names the first action.
if 子句說的是先做的事。
why: She says If housekeeping finishes early, I'll text you. So the hotel will contact the guest as soon as the room is ready. Keeping the bags comes after Otherwise.
她說 If housekeeping finishes early, I'll text you。房間一好，飯店就會通知客人。寄放行李在 Otherwise 之後。

gloss.ex: I made a reservation for two nights.
This is the least expensive option.
The suite has a small sitting area.
Guests can check in after noon.
Housekeeping cleans each room daily.

point: Reason: the opening problem.
原因題：開頭的問題就是答案。
why: He says his first flight sat on the runway for an hour, so he missed my connection. A delay kept him from boarding his next flight.
他說第一班 sat on the runway for an hour，所以 missed my connection。延誤讓他沒能搭上下一班。

point: Graphic: drop full, late and wrong-city rows.
圖表題：刪掉客滿、太晚和城市不對的列。
why: The two thirty flight is completely full, and the last one gets in too late. The only Lakeport flight between them leaves at 4:50 and lands at 6:35, so the gate is C3.
兩點半那班 completely full，最後一班 gets in too late。兩者之間唯一飛 Lakeport 的是 4:50 起飛、6:35 降落那班，所以是 C3 登機門。

point: Join his worry with her promise.
把他的疑慮和她的保證接起來。
why: His suitcase is checked through, and he says I don't have time to go to baggage claim. She answers Our baggage team will handle it from here. Airline staff will move the suitcase to his new flight.
他的行李已託運到底，他說 I don't have time to go to baggage claim。她答 Our baggage team will handle it from here。地勤會把行李轉到新班機。

gloss.ex: He missed his connection in the capital.
The plane waited on the runway.
We land at six tonight.
Meet me at the baggage claim.
Show your boarding pass at the gate.

point: Purpose: a guess is corrected.
目的題：猜測被更正。
why: He guesses Did she find a typo? She answers No, it's nothing like that and says the subtitle sounds written for professional chefs. The author is not satisfied with how the cover presents the book.
他猜 Did she find a typo?，她答 No, it's nothing like that，說副標題 sounds written for professional chefs。作者不滿意封面呈現這本書的方式。

point: An idiom: tall order means hard to do.
慣用語：tall order 是很難辦到。
why: She asks if he can make the change and still meet Thursday. He answers That's a tall order, then mentions a fee. The words take only an hour, so the request is hard because of cost and timing.
她問他能不能改完又趕上星期四。他答 That's a tall order，再提到費用。改字只要一小時，所以難處在費用和時程。

point: He gives the cost; she hands the decision to someone.
他報出費用，她把決定交給別人。
why: He says Four hundred dollars, plus an extra day. She replies it depends on the author. If she pays the fee herself, we'll go ahead. The change depends on whether the author will cover the charge.
他說 Four hundred dollars, plus an extra day。她答 it depends on the author. If she pays the fee herself, we'll go ahead。要不要改，看作者願不願意負擔費用。

gloss.ex: The subtitle explains the book's focus.
The proofs arrive on Monday.
Finishing by noon is a tall order.
I found a typo on page two.

point: Problem: the first sentence, not a late delivery.
問題題：看第一句，不是遲到。
why: Elena says half of today's fish never arrived. The fish did not come late; part of the order was never delivered.
Elena 說 half of today's fish never arrived。不是晚到，而是訂單有一部分根本沒送到。

point: An idiom: eggs in one basket means one big risk.
慣用語：eggs in one basket 是把風險押在同一處。
why: Gus wants to move all our seafood orders to one firm. Theo answers If they have one bad week, we have no fish at all. Relying on a single company is risky.
Gus 想把 all our seafood orders 都交給一家。Theo 回 If they have one bad week, we have no fish at all。只靠一家公司有風險。

point: Who asks, and who agrees.
誰提出需求、誰答應。
why: Gus says I'll need your weekend reservation numbers early in the week. Theo answers I'll give you the count every Tuesday morning. He agrees to give a weekly update on guest numbers.
Gus 說 I'll need your weekend reservation numbers early in the week。Theo 答 I'll give you the count every Tuesday morning。他答應每週提供客人人數。

gloss.ex: Our supplier raised its prices.
The cafe is full during the lunch rush.
Each portion serves two people.

gloss.w: put all our eggs in one basket
gloss.hw: put all one's eggs in one basket
gloss.zh: 孤注一擲、把風險押在同一處
gloss.ex: Do not put all your eggs in one basket.
We split the work between two teams.

point: Reason: car becomes vehicle.
原因題：car 換成 vehicle。
why: He says my car goes into the shop that morning. So he will not have his vehicle on the day of the session. The insurance question comes later.
他說 my car goes into the shop that morning。所以療程那天早上他沒有車可用。保險的問題是後面才問的。

point: Count the visits: five of six used.
算次數：六次用掉五次。
why: He has used five of the six visits. She says that one is covered. It will be your last. The Thursday session is the final visit his insurance will pay for.
他已用掉 five of the six visits。她說 that one is covered. It will be your last。星期四是保險最後給付的一次。

point: A rejected option is not the next step.
被否決的選項不是下一步。
why: She offers mail, or a fax from the doctor's office. He says Mail would take too long and I'd better hurry because the office closes at five. He will contact his physician.
她提出郵寄或由醫師診所傳真。他說 Mail would take too long，又說 I'd better hurry，因為診所五點關門。他會去聯絡醫師。

gloss.ex: She started physical therapy for her shoulder.
Does the plan cover dental visits?
A referral is required for specialists.
Please fax the form to our office.

point: Purpose: what the tables and permit are for.
目的題：桌子和許可證是為了什麼。
why: He wants to put four tables on the sidewalk, and she says he needs an outdoor seating permit. He is asking for permission to serve customers outside.
他想 put four tables on the sidewalk，她說他需要 an outdoor seating permit。他是來申請在戶外招待客人。

point: An if clause gives two choices.
if 子句給了兩個選擇。
why: He asks Will four tables fit? She answers If fewer fit, you can go ahead with fewer, or withdraw and get your fee back. Either way, the decision is his.
他問 Will four tables fit?，她答 If fewer fit, you can go ahead with fewer, or withdraw and get your fee back。不論哪一種，決定權都在他。

point: Next step: be right back shows where he goes.
下一步：be right back 說明他要去哪裡。
why: The form needs a drawing of the sidewalk. He says I have the building plans in my car. I'll bring them in. He will go and get a document from his vehicle.
表格 needs a drawing of the sidewalk。他說 I have the building plans in my car. I'll bring them in。他要去車上拿文件。

gloss.ex: You need a permit to build here.
The inspector visits every site.
The road is too narrow for trucks.
She chose to withdraw her application.
